1.title: ICE plans to equip agents with gloves that can deliver electric shocks
1.summary: The US immigration agency is spending $20m on gloves that deliver a sharp electric shock intended to compel subjects to comply.

2.title: Woman Arrested After Confessing to Starting Nevada Fire, Officials Say
2.summary: The woman was arrested on suspicion of arson and possession of a controlled substance. Officials said she set multiple fires that later became part of the Bug fire, which has burned over 66,000 acres.

3.title: Two dead after military helicopter crashes in Texas
3.summary: An Apache military helicopter crashed in central Texas, officials said Wednesday.

4.title: First Total Eclipse in Europe in Decades Turns Day to Night
4.summary: From Iceland to Spain, people flocked to viewing spots to see the moon completely block out the sun.

6.title: A Space Expert Hoped to Use the Eclipse as Science Class. The D.J.s Had Other Plans.
6.summary: Mar Carretero-Castrillo, an astrophysicist, returned to her remote village in Spain to be in the path of totality. Hundreds of  partygoers came too.
